note: Nothing in this file was inferred. Every open item lists who holds the information, where it is discoverable, and how to verify it against an official record before any decision is made.

questions.question: What is the parcel's exact street address, and is it inside City of Los Angeles limits or in an unincorporated area of the County?
questions.why_it_matters: Determines whether Measure ULA applies (4.45% / 5.95% all-in transfer tax), which City minimum wage applies ($18.42), and which hazard and school datasets bind.
questions.how_to_discover: Address on the lease or tax bill; confirm in the Assessor's parcel search (assessor.lacounty.gov); cross-check City annexation maps (finance.lacity.gov ULA FAQ lists incorporated vs unincorporated guidance).

questions.question: What is the Assessor Parcel Number and the current assessed (base-year) value?
questions.why_it_matters: Drives property tax carry (1% plus voter-approved debt per S34), the Prop 13 reset analysis for a buyer, and any 1031 replacement comparison.
questions.how_to_discover: Tax bill or assessor.lacounty.gov parcel lookup; county Auditor-Controller tax rate area for the exact rate (M90).

questions.question: What is the exact lease expiry date, and what renewal or extension options exist (count, length, rent formula)?
questions.why_it_matters: The 2030-2035 window is only known at the year level; option rent formulas often decide renew-vs-sell.
questions.how_to_discover: Lease document, amendments, and any option-notice correspondence.

questions.question: What are the current contract rent and the escalator (fixed % or CPI-linked, floor if any)?
questions.why_it_matters: Anchors every projection; escalator structure determines real rent erosion against 3.7% CPI (M96).
questions.how_to_discover: Lease and current rent roll; confirm with estoppel certificate from the tenant.

questions.question: Who is the tenant of record - the corporate entity or a local franchisee - and what guaranty backs the lease?
questions.why_it_matters: Corporate Jack in the Box leases carry the parent's covenant; franchisee leases depend on a much smaller operator. System data (S26) cannot answer this for the parcel.
questions.how_to_discover: Lease signature block and guaranty; confirm via tenant's estoppel; cross-check against JACK 10-K disclosure of company vs franchise restaurants (S27).

questions.question: What is the property's going-in cap rate from the latest appraisal or broker opinion?
questions.why_it_matters: The only official yield datapoint available is the 7.3% net-lease benchmark (M71); a subject-specific rate requires appraisal evidence.
questions.how_to_discover: Order a broker opinion of value or appraisal from a licensed CA appraiser; compare with recent net-lease trades in Central LA.

questions.question: What are the acquisition price, adjusted basis, and any debt on the property?
questions.why_it_matters: Needed to compute gain on sale (13.30% CA top marginal, M85) and to compare after-tax sale proceeds against a 1031 exchange. Private - published only in aggregate form in the model.
questions.how_to_discover: Closing statement, depreciation schedule (Form 4562), loan statements.

questions.question: What is the parcel's Fire Hazard Severity Zone class and flood zone?
questions.why_it_matters: Drives insurance availability and pricing; wildfire is an active black-swan (R21).
questions.how_to_discover: Address lookup on osfm.fire.ca.gov FHSZ maps (S14) and the FEMA flood map service center; request the parcel's zone in writing from the lender or insurer.

questions.question: What are the current property insurance carrier, premium, limits, and deductible structure (earthquake and wildfire included)?
questions.why_it_matters: After $23.87B of paid fire claims (M107), coverage terms can decide the hold case alone.
questions.how_to_discover: Current policy declarations page and renewal quote; loss-run for five years.

questions.question: Is the building seismically retrofitted (soft-story or non-ductile concrete assessment)?
questions.why_it_matters: 60% chance of an M6.7+ event in 30 years (M98); retrofit status affects insurance, financing and exit value.
questions.how_to_discover: City of LA building records for the address; engineer's report; seller disclosure.

questions.question: Is there a Phase I environmental site assessment, and any known contamination or adjacent-use risk?
questions.why_it_matters: Required for lender diligence and protects the buyer pool at exit.
questions.how_to_discover: Order a Phase I (ASTM E1527) from a licensed environmental consultant; check the GeoTracker and EnviroStor databases for the address.

questions.question: Are there title exceptions, easements, CC&Rs or reciprocal easement agreements that restrict use or sale?
questions.why_it_matters: Exceptions can block a 1031 replacement or reduce the buyer pool.
questions.how_to_discover: Preliminary title report from a CA title company.

questions.question: Can the tenant provide franchisee-level sales, occupancy costs and financial statements for this site?
questions.why_it_matters: System SSS is -1.1% (M112); site-level data decides renewal pricing and re-tenanting risk.
questions.how_to_discover: Request in renewal negotiation or via estoppel; franchise disclosure documents where the tenant is a franchisee.

questions.question: What NNN expense structure applies, and are tax, insurance and maintenance fully passed through with audit rights?
questions.why_it_matters: Decides who absorbs the insurance and property-tax shocks analyzed in the risk register.
questions.how_to_discover: Lease operating-expense clauses and the last two reconciliations.

questions.question: Does the owner intend to hold for sale, sell outright, or sell into a Section 1031 exchange?
questions.why_it_matters: Chains the tax answer (13.30% top rate on gain vs deferral) to the strategy; 1031 requires real property only (M86), 45/180-day timing (M87-M88) and a qualified intermediary.
questions.how_to_discover: Owner's tax counsel decision memo; basis and gain calculation from the depreciation schedule.

questions.question: What is the current fair market value, and would a sale price above or below the ULA threshold be achievable?
questions.why_it_matters: The tier-1 cliff at $5.4M changes all-in transfer tax from 0.11% (county only) to 4.45% (M73-M80).
questions.how_to_discover: Appraisal or broker opinion (Q06); test buyer demand in both price bands before listing.

questions.question: What rents and cap rates are actually being paid for comparable Central LA single-tenant net-lease or QSR pads in 2026?
questions.why_it_matters: The official benchmark (7.3% initial yield, M71) is diversified national, not Central LA.
questions.how_to_discover: Broker interviews (licensed CA commercial brokers), CoStar or Crexi comps (subscription), county transfer-records sampling for recent QSR trades.

questions.question: What is the submarket vacancy and asking-rent trend for freestanding QSR or retail pads in the immediate trade area?
questions.why_it_matters: Decides re-tenanting cost (R12) and the exit narrative.
questions.how_to_discover: Broker survey; county and city retail vacancy series from official planning documents where published.

questions.question: What are the owner's wealth-preservation, growth and risk-tolerance constraints (target return, hold horizon, liquidity needs)?
questions.why_it_matters: The model's recommendation weightings (wealth preservation vs growth) are policy inputs, not facts; without them the analysis stays neutral dual-track.
questions.how_to_discover: Owner questionnaire; document in a one-page investment policy statement before deciding.

questions.question: Can a lease extension or early renewal be negotiated before the expiry window opens?
questions.why_it_matters: An extension today may beat both a 2030-2035 sale in a weak market and a 1031 scramble at expiry.
questions.how_to_discover: Approach the tenant's real-estate or franchisee relations team with a term sheet (rent, escalator, options).

questions.question: Who handles re-tenanting: is the site pad-ready, and what is the drive-thru configuration worth to QSR users?
questions.why_it_matters: Drive-thru pads clear at tighter cap rates; this decides the fallback if the tenant leaves.
questions.how_to_discover: Site plan review, broker survey of QSR site demand in the county.

questions.question: Have the November 2026 results (Prop 3, Prop 43) been certified, and does any certification change the assumptions used here?
questions.why_it_matters: Results used are unofficial as of 2026-11-10 (M128-M130); certification is due 2026-12-11.
questions.how_to_discover: electionresults.sos.ca.gov after certification; re-run this workbook's legal page if numbers move.
